verdict.rationale: PayPal's own Payouts API is a real bulk capability: it sends batch payments to thousands of recipients at once by email, phone, or PayPal ID. That bulk support is documented only for disbursements; the agent toolkit and MCP tools (invoices, disputes, refunds, subscriptions, products) are all single-item operations. Missing for 10: bulk/batch operations beyond payouts (e.g., bulk invoicing, refunds, dispute actions), batch tools exposed through the agent toolkit/MCP server, documented batch size or status-tracking details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
